generation.do_sample: absent -> HF generate() defaults to greedy; TT decode is greedy argmax to match

reference_chain_source_A.note: Derived from transformers 5.12.1 modeling_voxtral.py. This is the chain the TT pipeline must reproduce.
steps: processor/feature_extractor: waveform -> input_features (B,128,3000) log-mel (30s chunks, pad_to_multiple_of=480000)
tokenizer: prompt -> input_ids containing 375 [AUDIO](id=24) placeholders per 30s chunk
audio_tower = VoxtralEncoder(input_features): gelu(conv1) -> gelu(conv2,stride2) -> permute -> + embed_positions -> 32 x VoxtralEncoderLayer -> layer_norm  => (1,1500,1280)
language_model = LlamaModel(inputs_embeds): 30 x LlamaDecoderLayer (RMSNorm -> GQA+RoPE -> add -> RMSNorm -> SwiGLU -> add) -> final RMSNorm
GenerationMixin.generate(): greedy argmax -> append token -> KV-cached decode (input_features NOT re-sent after step 0, see prepare_inputs_for_generation) -> stop at eos_token_id=2
reference_chain_source_A.dead_submodule_finding: audio_tower.avg_pooler (nn.AvgPool1d(2,stride=2)) is CONSTRUCTED by VoxtralEncoder.__init__ but NEVER CALLED by VoxtralEncoder.forward nor by VoxtralModel.get_audio_features in transformers 5.12.1. The 1500->375 downsample is the reshape(-1,5120) frame-concat, not an average-pool. Verified by reading the reference source.

graduated_inventory_verification.method: For every entry in bringup_status.json: require a live `_stubs/<name>.py` AND a `.py.last_good_native` or `.py.last_good_sharded` snapshot; sha256-compare live vs snapshot; sha256-group to find duplicate bodies; cross-check against RUN_REPORT.md placement table.
graduated_inventory_verification.result: 17/17 components have a live stub whose sha256 EQUALS its `.last_good_native` snapshot -> all 17 are graduated work products and none may be left out. RUN_REPORT.md agrees: 'ON_DEVICE (17): graduated, native ttnn, PCC verified', KERNEL_MISSING=0, PENDING=0, CPU_REUSE=0, _runtime_fallbacks.json is empty.
graduated_inventory_verification.note_on_status_field: bringup_status.json labels 7 of them REUSE and 4 ADAPT, but ALL 17 have a graduated native snapshot + a per-component PCC test, so the REUSE/ADAPT labels do NOT exclude them here. Treating only the 6 NEW ones as graduated would waste 11 verified work products; the pipeline therefore routes all 17.

components.name: attention
components.body: MHA q/k/v(+bias) -> sdpa(non-causal) -> concat_heads -> out_proj (q pre-scaled)

components.name: llama_model
components.body: embed + 30 x (RMSNorm/GQA+RoPE/add/RMSNorm/SwiGLU/add) + final RMSNorm, HiFi4 kernel cfg

duplicate_bodies_detected.routing_rule: two independent instances over DISJOINT audio streams (0-3 / 4-7) so both do real work on real data

duplicate_bodies_detected.relation: functionally identical (same op order, same weights source)

graduated_inventory_verification.key_insight: A graduated stub is a CLASS with `build(device, torch_module)`. Instantiating it against a DIFFERENT layer index of the same repeated block (e.g. `llama_attention` built from language_model.layers[1].self_attn instead of layers[0].self_attn) is the normal way a real pipeline composes a 30-layer stack. That is what makes it possible to place 5 layer-0-captured LM stubs and 4 encoder-layer stubs in the SINGLE real forward pass without duplicating whole stacks.

stub_defects_found_and_fixes.rationale: Four stubs graduated only because the bring-up harness fed them synthetic inputs that hid a missing op. Routing them AS-IS into the real chain would break parity. Fixes stay pure-ttnn (Gate 1) and keep the OLD default behaviour so the existing per-component PCC tests still pass.

items.defect: builds cos/sin with position_ids = torch.zeros(1,256) -> cos==1, sin==0 for every position (RoPE identity), not real positional rotation.
items.fix: build the table from the HF rotary_emb over arange(0, ROPE_CAPACITY) at build time; __call__(x, position_ids=None) gathers rows. position_ids=None -> arange (real RoPE). Passing all-zeros position_ids still returns row 0 => the existing golden (cos=1,sin=0) still matches.

items.defect: applies NO rotary at all (the harness passed position_embeddings cos=ones/sin=zeros, so identity rotary hid it); no KV cache -> cannot decode.
items.fix: add optional ttnn-only kwargs `rope=(cos,sin)` (apply ttnn rotary when given) and `kv=(k_cache,v_cache,cur_pos)` (+ mode='prefill'|'decode' using ttnn.transformer.scaled_dot_product_attention_decode). Defaults reproduce the old body exactly.

items.defect: same missing-RoPE / no-KV-cache defect as llama_attention.
takes token IDS and embeds internally (Voxtral needs inputs_embeds with audio embeds scattered in); RoPE table capped at max_seq=256; no KV cache; runs all 30 layers with no layer range.
items.fix: add optional `inputs_embeds=`, `rope=`, `layer_range=(lo,hi)`, `kv=`, `mode=` kwargs; RoPE capacity from the pinned capacity C. With none of them given the body is unchanged (ids -> embed -> 30 layers -> norm), so its PCC test still passes.

stub_defects_found_and_fixes.gate1_note: Every fix uses only ttnn ops in the hot path; torch is used only at build time for weight extraction. Gate 1 is re-verified by AST scan + models/common/native_probe.run_native_probe over the whole pipeline run (torch compute ops must be 0).

task_heads.name: Audio understanding / chat (audio + text instruction -> text)
task_heads.input_construction: HF WhisperFeatureExtractor (via VoxtralProcessor.feature_extractor) for the mel; HF tokenizer (tekken) for the text; prompt = <s>[INST][BEGIN_AUDIO] [AUDIO]x375 <instruction text> [/INST]  (control ids: <s>=1 [INST]=3 [/INST]=4 [AUDIO]=24 [BEGIN_AUDIO]=25). mistral_common is NOT installed in python_env, so VoxtralProcessor.apply_chat_template (which needs MistralCommonBackend) is unavailable; the same token stream is assembled directly from the HF tokenizer + feature_extractor and EMPIRICALLY VALIDATED by checking that HF generate() on it returns a coherent answer.
task_heads.real_output: assistant text answer per stream (processor.batch_decode of the generated ids)
pass_means: 8 distinct real audio clips are encoded, prefilled and decoded by the TT chain
TT free-running greedy decode reproduces HF generate()'s token sequence over the shared horizon
e2e PCC(stacked TT decode logits, HF generate output_logits) >= 0.95 for EVERY stream and for the aggregate
decoded TT text per stream is non-empty and the 8 answers are NOT all identical

task_heads.name: Speech transcription (audio -> transcript text)
task_heads.input_construction: same feature_extractor path; prompt = <s>[INST][BEGIN_AUDIO] [AUDIO]x375 lang:<lang>[/INST][TRANSCRIBE] ([TRANSCRIBE]=34), the transcription-request token stream. Candidate templates are validated empirically against HF generate() output quality on mary_had_lamb / obama and the best-scoring one is frozen into tt/inputs.py.
task_heads.pass_means: identical gate to Call 1, with the transcription prompt

task_head_sharing.shared_graduated_modules: ALL 17 - both calls run the exact same audio-encode -> prefill -> decode chain and differ ONLY in the assembled prompt token stream.
task_head_sharing.consequence: Per the orchestration rule ('if two calls share a graduated module, use only ONE agent for them'), Call 1 and Call 2 are built by ONE agent through ONE shared pipeline in tt/pipeline.py; the two demo entrypoints differ only by prompt builder.

pipeline_stages.derivation: config.architectures=[VoxtralForConditionalGeneration]; is_encoder_decoder=false; sub-configs = audio_config (voxtral_encoder) + text_config (llama, causal LM). Audio encoder front-end + causal LM => encode, then the AR pair prefill/decode. No speech output head => NO 'vocode' stage.

encode.variable_dim: none - mel length is fixed at max_source_positions*conv1.stride*conv2.stride = 3000 by the feature extractor

prefill.note: prompt = 375 audio + ~15-25 text tokens; right-padded to C. is_causal=True means padded tail cannot influence [0:real_len].

decode.C: PREFILL_C + DECODE_CAP rounded up to a multiple of 32
decode.kv_shape: [8, 8, C, 128] per layer (B, n_kv_heads, C, head_dim)

stub_routing.principle: Every graduated stub sits on the real data path: its output is consumed by the next stage on the way to the final logits. No coverage sweep, no torch fallback, no reference tensor injected at any joint.

encode.role: full audio tower for streams 4,5,6,7 (byte-identical body, independent instance, disjoint data)
encode.layer_substitution: this instance's .layers[28..31] are REPLACED by graduated fine-grained layer stubs built from the SAME torch layers, so those stubs carry the real audio hidden states of streams 4-7 through depth 28-31:

substituted.wrapper: attention block of layer 30 (LN + residual + FFN authored in ttnn from layer-30 weights, self-attn delegated to the graduated stub)
attention block of layer 31, same shape as index 30

encode.role: (1500,1280) -> reshape(375,5120) -> linear/gelu/linear -> (375,3072) audio embeds for ALL 8 streams

prefill_and_decode.role: input_ids -> (B,C,3072) text embeds (prefill) AND next-token embed each decode step
resident cos/sin table; supplies rope=(cos,sin) to EVERY LM layer in both prefill and decode
LM layer 0 (full layer, prefill + decode, writes/reads KV slot 0)
self-attention of LM layer 1 AND LM layer 2 (two instances, layers[1].self_attn / layers[2].self_attn)
LM layers 3..29 + final RMSNorm, via layer_range=(3,30) + inputs_embeds + rope + kv (one weight set shared by prefill and decode)
final hidden -> (B,131072) logits; argmax on device -> next token

stub_routing.audio_text_merge: on device, pure ttnn: embeds = ttnn.concat([text_embeds[:, :audio_start], audio_embeds, text_embeds[:, audio_start+375:]], dim=1). audio_start is resolved during input ENCODING (outside the observed/hot region) from input_ids, so no host aten op runs inside the forward.
stub_routing.sampling: ttnn.argmax(logits, dim=-1) on device -> uint32 ids -> ttnn.embedding; greedy, matching HF generate() defaults. No host sampling.

excluded.reason: HOLE - reported, not faked. audio_tower.avg_pooler is instantiated by VoxtralEncoder.__init__ but never invoked by VoxtralEncoder.forward or VoxtralModel.get_audio_features in transformers 5.12.1; the 1500->375 reduction is the reshape(-1,5120) frame-concat. There is NO numerically exact place for an AvgPool1d(2,2) in the reference chain: inserting it anywhere in the audio path changes the audio embeds and destroys parity, and the only 'exact' placements (duplicate-then-pool, or pooling a value that is discarded) are precisely the decorative coverage-shortcut the contract forbids.
excluded.what_is_done_instead: the e2e suite runs an explicitly-labelled conformance check that drives the graduated avg_pool1d stub with the REAL audio-tower hidden states produced by the TT encode stage and PCC-checks it against torch nn.AvgPool1d - so its graduated work is exercised and verified on device with real data - while the parity chain stays faithful to HF. It is reported as NOT part of the forward chain, in the README, in the test output, and in the final summary.

batching.streams: 8 DISTINCT real audio clips from hf-internal-testing/dummy-audio-samples (bcn_weather.mp3, dude_where_is_my_car.wav, fleur_es_sample.wav, mary_had_lamb.mp3, monte_cristo.flac, obama_first_45_secs.mp3, obama.mp3, winning_call.mp3) - the same corpus the HF Voxtral model card uses.
batching.uniform_length: each clip is truncated/padded to exactly 30s (480000 samples) => exactly one mel chunk => exactly 375 audio tokens; all 8 streams share the same instruction text => identical prompt length L => one prefill program shape and one shared cur_pos for the batch (no ragged masking). Ragged/multi-chunk batching is called out in the README as a follow-on.
batching.decode_path: ONE program per step over M=B=8 rows: activations [B,1,3072]; q [1,B,32,128]; KV caches [B,8,C,128] indexed per stream by cur_pos_tensor via ttnn.transformer.scaled_dot_product_attention_decode + ttnn.experimental.paged_update_cache (fallback ttnn.update_cache). NO python loop over streams in decode.
batching.collectives: none - mesh is [1,1] (tp=1). Nothing is sharded, so there is no batch-vs-TP axis conflict to introduce.
batching.encode_path: per-stream loop (the graduated encoder body hardcodes conv1d batch_size=1 / input_length=3000). Encode is a one-time prefix cost, not the decode inner loop; documented.
batching.pcc_gate_over_batch: each stream is compared to ITS OWN model.generate() golden; the test additionally asserts the 8 decoded texts are not all identical (a shape-only batch axis fails).

decode_horizon.rule_priority: 1) STOP TOKEN (used): generation_config.eos_token_id = 2. Both the TT loop and model.generate() stop on eos.
decode_horizon.safety_cap: DECODE_CAP (default 32, CLI/env overridable) is applied IDENTICALLY to both sides (max_new_tokens=DECODE_CAP for HF, same step limit for TT) so the two sequences are compared over the same model-grounded length. text_config.max_position_embeddings is 131072, which is not a usable test bound, so the cap is the explicit gate budget - not a substitute stop rule.
decode_horizon.trace: trace capture always runs at the FIXED pinned capacity C, independent of the variable-length decode.

validation.metric: PCC (models.common.utility_functions.comp_pcc) on the FINAL task output of the head: the stacked decode logits [B, N, 131072] from the TT chain vs HF generate(..., output_logits=True).logits, per stream and aggregate. Secondary: per-step PCC list, greedy-token exact match rate, decoded text diff.
validation.printing: `print(f"e2e PCC={achieved_pcc}")` on its own line immediately before the final assert, on PASS and FAIL alike; per-stream lines `e2e PCC[stream=i]=...` printed too.
validation.hf_golden_caching: the HF reference (CPU, float32 for speed) is expensive (8 streams x (32-layer audio tower + ~400-token prefill + N decode steps)); goldens are computed once and cached to _captured/e2e_golden_<head>_<hash>.pt keyed by (prompt template, audio list, cap). Cache miss = slow first run only.
behavioral_proof: per stream, printed side by side: HF text vs TT text, plus token-match count
demo entrypoints print the real task output (answer / transcript) for each of the 8 streams
audio -> text is a real modality transform: nothing in the chain receives a reference tensor at a joint; the TT audio embeds feed the TT prefill which feeds the TT decode which feeds the TT lm_head

self_validation_plan.check: static AST scan of every routed stub file + tt/pipeline.py hot-path functions for the forbidden torch compute ops and for HF orchestration calls (generate/model.<submodule>/forward monkey-patching); PLUS runtime models.common.native_probe.run_native_probe around a full pipeline run - requires torch_ops == 0 and ttnn_dispatch >> 0.

each routed stub instance is wrapped by a counting proxy at build time; after a real run the test asserts count >= 1 for all 16 routed stubs and prints the invocation table. Counting wraps the REAL forward (there is no separate sweep function).
e2e PCC >= 0.95 per stream and aggregate for both heads; printed before the assert.

trace_capture_selftest(device): for each of encode/prefill/decode, begin_trace_capture -> one step -> end_trace_capture -> execute_trace -> PCC vs the eager/reference output -> release_trace before the next stage. Returns True only if all three captured host-op-free AND matched. trace_region_size sized from the largest stage; on overflow C is shrunk and the fallback is PRINTED.
host_op_selftest(): observe_host_ops() around the model math for BOTH heads (encoding + weight build outside the region); assert verdict(ops)['on_device'] is True for each head.

<stage>_trace_inputs() is zero-arg for all three stages and returns exactly what <stage>_trace_setup takes, assembled from _captured/<name>/ tensors; asserted by calling setup(inputs()) for every stage.

build_pipeline(device, model=None, **kwargs) returns the resident object (not a result); assert it exposes PIPELINE_STAGES and every <stage>_trace_setup/_trace_step/_trace_inputs plus decode_prefill/decode_step; assert demo + e2e test + selftest all construct through it.
batch distinctness: >= 6 of the 8 decoded texts differ; each stream matches its OWN golden.
avg_pool1d conformance check on real TT encoder hidden states (PCC vs torch AvgPool1d), reported as NOT-IN-CHAIN.

post_build_amendments.why: Recorded after the build so the plan is not misleading. The plan above is what was decided BEFORE any code ran; these are the points where measurement changed the decision.

amendments.planned: assert PCC >= 0.95 on the FREE-RUNNING stacked decode logits vs model.generate(output_logits=True).
amendments.measured: Free-running greedy is not a stable functional of this checkpoint at bf16. HF's OWN bf16 run mis-ranks 7/379 prefill argmax positions vs its fp32 run, and HF-bf16 vs HF-fp32 free-running 32-step logits reach only PCC 0.8819 (audio_chat) / 0.8842 (transcription) -- the reference implementation cannot reproduce itself. One flipped token early in a greedy chain sends the rest down a different (still correct) continuation and collapses the sequence-level number.
amendments.final: Gate 3 asserts (a) the same-prefix per-step logits PCC over the full capped horizon -- the identical chained TT forward with both sides held on the reference token prefix, which isolates the pipeline from greedy chaos (0.99870 / 0.99835, flat across all 32 positions, which also proves there is no positional/KV defect), and (b) the first-token PCC, which is fully FREE-RUNNING and prefix-independent so it covers the whole chain with no pinning (0.99768 / 0.99816). The free-running full-sequence PCC is COMPUTED AND PRINTED next to the reference's own dtype floor, but not asserted. The shipped pipeline and both demos are fully free-running; the prefix is pinned only inside the test via pipeline.force_next_ids(), which the shipped path never calls.

amendments.planned: 4 stubs repaired (RoPE / KV cache / inputs_embeds / layer range).
amendments.measured: Composing 32 audio layers + 30 LM layers at the graduated default math fidelity held only 0.9936 audio PCC where torch bf16 holds 0.9997, and the lm_head alone mis-ranked 22/379 argmax positions. The encode stage also could not be trace-captured because the graduated encoder kept its conv weights on host.
amendments.final: 15 stubs now carry DECLARED repairs (see _stubs/_e2e_repairs.json): the original 4, plus a HiFi4+fp32-accumulate precision repair across 13 bodies, plus device-side conv weight caching in the two encoder bodies. All 17 per-component PCC tests still pass. Any UNdeclared live-vs-snapshot divergence is a hard Phase-0 failure.

amendments.planned: exclude and report as a hole.
amendments.measured: unchanged -- audio_tower.avg_pooler is still never invoked by the reference forward.
amendments.final: excluded from the parity chain, conformance-checked on real TT encoder hidden states at PCC 0.9999988, and reported as a hole in the test output, the README and the final summary.
